video_title: Latest Trade Rumblings, Clippers, Nets, Bucks Selling Who Is Buying?

quotes.speaker: Trevor Lane
quotes.summary_phrase: Rob Pelinka's annual promise of Lakers activity at trade deadline
quotes.excerpt: Rob Pelinka says the Lakers will be active at the trade deadline. To be fair, he says this every year.
quotes.quote: Rob Pelinka says the Lakers will be active at the trade deadline. To be fair, he says this every year. He does say something to this effect that they will be active, but they are off to a good start to the season. They have only lost three games at this point, and we know that they have some things that they certainly need to get. Now, whether or not they have the assets to get those things will be potentially another story, but it sounds like the Lakers are going to be aggressive, looking to try to get some things done and give this team the pieces that they need to make a real run this year.
quotes.social_post: Rob Pelinka is signaling the Lakers will be aggressive at the trade deadline. While they have a strong start to the season, the front office knows they need to add pieces to make a real run.

quotes.speaker: Keith Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers actively seeking a backup center before trade deadline
quotes.excerpt: The other report related to this one was that they are actively looking for a backup center.
quotes.quote: The other report related to this one was that they are actively looking for a backup center, which in my opinion is probably the single biggest hole you can see on the team. There are other things you could always shore up. You can never have enough shooting, you can never have enough wing defense, but I think it is the backup center spot where they need to get something. And the good news is, someone will always be available at that spot come trade deadline.
quotes.social_post: The Lakers are actively hunting for a backup center before the trade deadline. It is widely considered the biggest hole on the roster right now.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Lane
quotes.summary_phrase: Gabe Vincent signing with Kings as a veteran presence
quotes.excerpt: The Kings signed Gabe Vincent. All the Kings had to do was show they could win a home game.
quotes.quote: The Kings signed Gabe Vincent. All the Kings had to do was show they could win a home game, and then that convinced Gabe Vincent to sign. This was the prove-it game for the Kings to show Gabe Vincent what they can do. I look at a guy like Gabe Vincent who was bounced around the league, has been a lot of different teams, a lot of different situations, but when we think about the veteran leadership on Sacramento, you have Domantas Sabonis, who is one foot out the door, the Kings would probably prefer two feet out the door. De'Aaron Fox, one foot out the door, the Kings would prefer two feet out the door. Gabe Vincent at least is a guy coming in, understands the situation. He may not be long for the team either. Who knows? Maybe he stays five years there, we don't know. But it is only a one-year deal, but still, coming in with a different perspective than the guys who have been there for years and are very clearly not part of the future. So I think Gabe Vincent being a part of this locker room is going to be a good thing overall for the development of De'Aaron Fox.
quotes.social_post: Gabe Vincent is heading to the Kings. It is a one year deal, but his veteran presence could be a positive influence for the development of De'Aaron Fox.

quotes.speaker: Keith Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell's hamstring injury status and re-evaluation timeline
quotes.excerpt: There was no timeline given, and even the Bulls statement on this said a mild right hamstring strain.
quotes.quote: There was no timeline given, and even the Bulls statement on this said a mild right hamstring strain. So we will be hopeful. They did say he will be re-evaluated later this week. So that is probably the best you can have with this. I will remind everyone, it is a little bit of a weird schedule coming up over the next couple of weeks because you have teams that are waiting for those extra games. They are not extra games, I should not call them that because I don't want people thinking the NBA Cup added more games to the schedule, but it is kind of the final two games to be added to the schedule for all the teams that don't make it into the NBA Cup knockout portions.
quotes.social_post: Norman Powell is dealing with a mild right hamstring strain. No official timeline has been set, but he is expected to be re-evaluated later this week.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Lane
quotes.summary_phrase: Nolan Traore out 8-10 weeks with hamstring injury
quotes.excerpt: Nolan Traore is going to be out dealing with this hamstring injury.
quotes.quote: Nolan Traore is going to be out dealing with this hamstring injury. Hamstrings can be tricky, just ask anyone what can happen there. Not great for a Chicago Bulls team that is already without Caleb Wilson right now. Eight to 10 weeks, this tells you this is probably, again, not a doctor, this is a medical opinion here, but this is probably like grade two hamstring strain. Not good, obviously, and a guy who I think was starting to figure some things out, too. So, really unfortunate that now Nolan Traore is going to be out dealing with this hamstring injury.
quotes.social_post: Tough news for the Bulls as Nolan Traore is set to miss 8 to 10 weeks with a hamstring injury.

quotes.speaker: Trevor Lane
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers expected to be sellers at the trade deadline
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers are expecting trade interest in their veterans, to the point where a recent report suggested.
quotes.quote: The Clippers are expecting trade interest in their veterans, to the point where a recent report suggested that the Clippers are actually showcasing their veteran starting guys like Brook Lopez in order to get a little more interest in them around the NBA. They have got a lot of guys that are on expiring contracts, even Rui Hachimura is on a team option on the second year of the deal. Players like Max Strus you can throw into that mix as well. So the Clippers are a team that will probably be a seller here between now and the trade deadline. So certainly a team to keep an eye on. I also thought there was some reporting that suggested that they be, they understand that most of their guys are probably like multiple second-round pick guys.
quotes.social_post: The Clippers are expected to be sellers at the trade deadline. Reports suggest they are currently showcasing veterans like Brook Lopez to drum up interest from around the league.

quotes.speaker: Keith Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks open to moving veteran players before trade deadline
quotes.excerpt: The Bucks are open to moving veteran players by the trade deadline.
quotes.quote: The Bucks are open to moving veteran players by the trade deadline. This makes a lot of sense for Milwaukee to potentially take some of their players and move them in order to get more win-now pieces. The first name though, Tyler Herro, is he included in this? Is he a player that the Bucks should look to move on from the hometown kid, or should they be talking a new deal with Tyler Herro? I am the shrug emoji guy. I don't know. I mean, he was awesome on their game on Saturday. That, maybe the most egregiously missed out-of-bounds call I have ever seen. Joel Embiid was a legit full foot out of bounds. And then Tyler Herro, just, I mean, a millisecond late on releasing a three-pointer that would have tied it. But 50 points over the weekend for him. Herro is, yeah, it is hard because next contract is going to take him into his early 30s. What are you going to have to pay him? Now the Bucks are very well set up salary-wise as far as their cap sheet goes. Should have cap space this summer if they want to go that direction. But yeah, that is one that, that is a tough one because he is probably the most valuable guy that they could get something for on this roster, because I don't think you are getting much for Myles Turner. I don't think you are getting much for Kyle Kuzma. Gary Trent Jr., whatever. Caris LeVert, you are not getting anything for. I think the next most valuable trade piece on the roster is probably AJ Green.
quotes.social_post: The Bucks are open to moving veteran players. A big question remains regarding Tyler Herro and whether the team should look to move on or commit to a new deal.
